name: Segment whole-brain tractogram -  Parcellation
summary: Segments a whole-brain tractogram into streamlines that connect a parcellation's labels with MRtrix3 tck2connectome and connectome2tck, and outputs the merged tractogram.
description: Assigns every streamline to the parcels at its two endpoints with tck2connectome, extracts streamlines per parcel with connectome2tck and concatenates them into one .tck. With both_endpoints set, only streamlines whose two endpoints fall in the same parcel are kept. The parcellation must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: Volumetric parcellation whose labels define the segmentation.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

outputs.description: Tractogram (.tck) of the streamlines assigned to the parcellation's labels.

parameters.description: If true, keep only streamlines whose two endpoints fall in the same parcel.
